name: roys-loop
description: Role rules for Roy's PMs (dot, Hermes, grokbot; status reports only), the Orca floating coordinator (one per project) and Orca workers: routing, ownership, PR review and release scope. Content only.

interface.shortDescription: PM, coordinator and worker role rules
interface.longDescription: One Orca floating coordinator per project runs the work through Orca workers, with PR-scoped coordinator /code-review, preserved ownership and coordinator-decided release scope; PMs (dot, Hermes, grokbot) only report status and relay. Adds no loop, ledger, polling or automation.
defaultPrompt: Use $roys-loop to route this goal through the Orca coordinator.
